title: Seating
description: Place the tables on the plan and the guests at the tables. You can drag with a finger or use the buttons: both do the same thing.

empty.title: First choose the room plan
empty.body: Seating is done on the plan of the space: the venue's, or one you describe.

newerDrawing.title: The venue has published a newer version of the plan
newerDrawing.link: See what changes, in Room plan

publish.title: What guests see
publish.offBody: For now guests see nothing of the seating. After publishing, each one sees only their own table on their link.
publish.onBody: Published on {date}. Each guest sees their table (and seat, if you chose one) on their link. Nobody sees anyone else's name.

changes.published: You can now see your table.

stage.hint: You are in the stage “{name}”. What you move or put away here applies to this stage only; the base layout stays the same.
stage.awayNote: Not in the room during the stage “{name}”.
stage.sheetBody: Each stage has its own layout variant and its own fit check: for dancing, for example, you take out a few tables and extend the dance floor.
stage.sameAsBase: In this stage it is the same as in the base layout.

fit.label: Fit check, base layout

problemsVerdict.one: Does not fit: one placement problem

missingVerdict.one: Does not fit: one seat missing

fit.unknownFloor: Unknown: the room's dimensions are not known
fit.unknownSeats: Unknown: some tables have no seat count

invitedMissing.one: one more seat would be needed for everyone
invitedMissing.few: {count} more seats would be needed for everyone
invitedMissing.other: {count} more seats would be needed for everyone

fit.excluded: {name} ({kind}) has no dimensions: it is left out of the check.
fit.seatsUnknownLine: {name} has no seat count: its seats are not counted.

issues.tooClose: {a} and {b} are too close: {gap} cm of passage is left, the minimum is {min} cm.
issues.overInventory: There are {count} more “{name}” tables than the venue has.

bar.label: Actions for {name}
bar.unknownDims: Its dimensions are not known, so it is left out of the fit check. Fill them in under “Edit”.
bar.overCapacity: There are {over} more people than seats.
bar.placeHint: Touch the place on the plan where you want it.
bar.stepLabel: Step of {cm} cm. Touch to change the step.

add.title: Add to the plan
add.venueHint: From the inventory the venue states, with its dimensions.
add.what: Or add something of your own
add.customNote: What you add is drawn with a dashed line and is not presented as the venue's.
add.presetHint: Common hire sizes. You can change anything after choosing.

fields.name: Name
fields.tableNameHint: For example “Long table”. If you leave it empty, we call it “Own table”.
fields.label: Number or name of the table
fields.labelHint: Shown on the plan and on the guests' link: “3” or “Couple”.
fields.seatsHint: One chair per place; the chairs show on the plan.

tables.title: Tables ({count})
tables.empty: No table on the plan. Add the first one with the button above.
tables.emptyRead: No table on the plan yet.

unseated.title: Not seated ({count})
unseated.noGuests: The guest list is empty. Add guests under “Guests and replies”.
unseated.how: Touch a table in the list or on the plan, then tick who sits at it.

position.title: Position of {name}
position.body: The centre, measured from the top-left corner of the plan.

edit.title: Edit “{name}”
edit.venueFacts: The dimensions and seats are those stated by the venue and cannot be changed here.

remove.title: Take {name} off the plan?
remove.body: You can add it again at any time.
remove.bodySeated: The people seated at it ({count}) go back to the not-seated list.

assign.everyoneSeated: Every guest already has a seat.

submitCount.one: Seat one person at the table

assign.tooMany: You chose {picked} people, but only {left} seats are free.

export.title: Seating
export.description: The list with each guest's table and seat (CSV).

whatif.title: Seating proposal — tables: {count}
whatif.at: {x} m from the left, {y} m from the top
whatif.newVenue: New table from the venue's inventory
whatif.excluded: Items without dimensions, left out of the check: {count}

guest.title: Your seat
guest.several: Your family sits at several tables:
guest.planLabel: Room plan with your table marked
guest.planNote: Your table is the ringed one.

errors.network: We could not save. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.reloaded: We reloaded the layout as it is saved now.
errors.measure: Type a measure in metres, for example 1.8.
errors.bothSides: Type both sides or leave both empty.
errors.seats: Type the number of seats (60 at most).
errors.count: Type how many tables, between 1 and 40.
errors.rotation: Type the rotation in degrees, between 0 and 360.
errors.conflict: Someone else moved table “{label}” meanwhile. We kept their move; check and move it again if needed.
errors.itemGone: This item is no longer on the plan. Someone else may have removed it.
errors.tooManyItems: The plan can hold at most {max} items.
errors.unknownTableType: The venue does not have this table type.
errors.inventoryExhausted: The venue has only {count} “{name}” tables and all are already on the plan. Add a table of your own.
errors.venueFact: The dimensions of the venue's tables are stated by the venue and cannot be changed here.
errors.tooManyStages: You can have at most {max} stages.
errors.guestGone: This guest is no longer on the list.
errors.tableFull: Table {label} has {free} free seats and you chose {wanted}. Choose fewer people or another table.
errors.seatTaken: Seat {seatNo} already belongs to someone else at this table.
